newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer CEO more cautious about outlook.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer CEO more cautious about outlook.

text.p: Sulzer AG chief executive officer Fritz Fahrni still expected better results for the engineering group for all of 1996, but said he was not as optimistic as he was in April.
"I have become more cautious," he said in response to a question at a news conference to present half-year results.
Fahrni said the group was still optimistic about its outlook for 1996.
"But not to the same degree as we were in April," he said.
He also denied having made a forecast earlier for a profit rise in 1996 which would take profits back to 1994 levels.
